title: Bigelow's $22 million program steered by Colonel Alexander
summary: Steven Greer tells of Bigelow's $22 million program steered by Colonel Alexander, about 2008-2010 at Las Vegas, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
